mapper.insert: INSERT INTO routines (routine_id, member_id, routine_name, description) VALUES (SEQ_ROUTINES.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{routineName}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT routine_id, member_id, routine_name, description, created_at, updated_at FROM routines WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, routine_id DESC
